import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    if not data:
        return

    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    q = int(next(it))

    bit = [0] * (n + 1)

    def add(i, x):
        while i <= n:
            bit[i] += x
            i += i & -i

    def prefix_sum(i):
        s = 0
        while i > 0:
            s += bit[i]
            i -= i & -i
        return s

    out = []
    for _ in range(q):
        op = next(it).decode()
        if op == "add":
            i = int(next(it))
            x = int(next(it))
            add(i, x)
        else:  # getSum
            s = int(next(it))
            t = int(next(it))
            out.append(str(prefix_sum(t) - prefix_sum(s - 1)))

    sys.stdout.write("\n".join(out))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
